tree.heading: Assistant Secretary
tree.text: The term “Assistant Secretary” means the Assistant Secretary for the Countering Weapons of Mass Destruction Office.

tree.heading: Intelligence community
tree.text: The term “intelligence community” has the meaning given such term in section 3003(4) of title 50.

tree.heading: Office
tree.text: The term “Office” means the Countering Weapons of Mass Destruction Office established under section 591(a) of this title.

tree.heading: Weapon of mass destruction
tree.text: The term “weapon of mass destruction” has the meaning given the term in section 1801 of title 50.

ancestors.heading: COUNTERING WEAPONS OF MASS DESTRUCTION OFFICE
